name: Text-cleanup
tagline: Cleans up writing you already have into one send-ready version
description: Hand it a rough paragraph - a reply typed too fast, notes pasted out of a document, wording that came through a translator badly - and a single edited version comes back. It works on text that already exists instead of inventing new copy, so what returns is still yours, only clearer.
author: Bill
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
